ledger.claim: Filing party is the RIDER, so the question is whether the rider keeps carrying the 6.50 the trip was charged over quote; the trace answers it. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not the rounded trip_record copy: the trace measures 16.32 km against a platform-stored optimal of 12.1 km, an excess of 4.22 km. That is 34.88% of optimal (well over the 20% limb) and 4.22 km absolute (well over the 0.8 km limb), so both establishment tests pass and the route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own measurement.

The trace cannot be attacked as broken. POL-RD-07 impairs a trace only on a gap over 90 seconds, a straight-line step over 500 m, or a sustained sampling interval over 30 seconds; this trace carries 164 fixes at a 10 second cadence, a maximum gap of 10 seconds, no gaps at all, and a largest consecutive step of 150.1 m. None of limbs (a) to (c) is met, so no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required and the deviation may stand on the trace alone.

The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged. The artifacts describe the same trip - TRP-04004 on the trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown alike, with the pickup/start of the trace at 20:47:20 matching the trip_record started_at to the second - and limb (b) is satisfied by the 4.22 km / 34.88% excess measured from an unimpaired trace. Nothing further is demanded of the rider here: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the 4-or-more / 1-or-fewer corroboration gate in POL-RD-08 does not open, and POL-GEN-01 confines that counter to that test alone.

The burden now sits on the driver, and he has not discharged it. POL-RD-08 requires a specific artifact and a specific clause; the counterparty_statement says only 'I just follow the navigation' and cites no evidence id and no clause at all, so it carries no weight and is discarded.

No rider instruction caused this detour. The chat_log holds exactly two messages, both pickup logistics ('blue Niro at PLQ drop off point', 'ok coming'), neither from the rider naming a place or road, and neither carrying a waypoint_hint. POL-RD-04's corroboration test is therefore undecidable on the record and the clause is unavailable, so no distance is excluded; POL-RD-14 confirms that a request the trace did not follow would not have excluded anything anyway.

The driver's implicit traffic excuse is weightless. No traffic_advisory covers this trip window: EV-ADVIS-04004-01 is present only as a minted identifier, status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - so I disclose that impairment, and rely on the absence, which is itself citable. The driver cites no advisory id of his own, so under POL-RD-13 the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and his assertion neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. The deviation therefore stands at the measured figure.

This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip (quoted_fare_sgd 17.90, fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE), so POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: no distance-or-time refund is claimed, because those lines were fixed at booking. What the rider is owed is limb (a) - the amount by which charged_total exceeds the quote plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09.

Run that arithmetic on the ledger and it lands on the whole contested amount. Charged total 24.40 less quoted fare 17.90 = 6.50; every properly chargeable line is zero - erp_total 0.00 (the fare_breakdown carries no gantry lines), airport_surcharge 0.00 (nothing is itemised and this trip does not originate at an airport), waiting_time_fee 0.00 - so properly_chargeable totals 0.00 and the refund is 6.50, i.e. the 6.50 the rider was charged over quote, to the cent.

No competing baseline rescues the driver. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-apply, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12's pooled-itinerary baseline does not exist here. 12.1 km stands as the optimal.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, so this can and should be ruled on rather than escalated. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-04004); the timestamps are causally ordered and none runs backwards; the trace is not impaired; the computed remedy of 6.50 is nowhere near the 150.00 ceiling or charged_total; and no charge line lacks a counterpart, since there are no charge lines beyond base, distance, time and platform fee. With a refund of 6.50 on a rider-filed dispute where payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, the rider is entirely right and the whole contested amount is returned - a FULL_REFUND under POL-GEN-03. NO_ACTION would leave the rider still carrying the disputed 6.50 and is not supportable on this record.

The rider's own measured excess is 4.22 km, or 34.88% of the 12.10 km booked optimal. That clears the POL-RD-01 establishment gate of 0.8 km and 20%, but it falls below BOTH of the clause's material limbs of 8.0 km and 50%. The deviation is therefore established and NOT material, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged by materiality on this trip: the FULL_REFUND uplift in limb (b) and the driver-conduct referral in limb (c) are both unavailable, and this trip's own trace is the only thing that can make it a deviation.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern to weigh against this driver. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 280, a ratio of 0.000, below both the 3-flag limb and the 0.05-with-at-least-40-trips limb of POL-RD-06. The lifetime counter driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags (2) is not the field POL-RD-06 names and POL-GEN-01 forbids reading the lifetime counter in place of the trailing-90-day figure, so no adverse finding may be built on it.

ledger.claim: This was an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: fare_breakdown.fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 17.90, and the only record of the re-rate is a PLATFORM_TELEMETRY event, not a driver action. Under POL-RD-11 POL-RD-02 does not run on an upfront-quoted trip and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however large the excess, so the rider cannot enlarge this into a metered recomputation or recover the charged total of 24.40; the recovery is confined to the arithmetic of POL-RD-11(a) and the platform's own figure for it is 6.50.

No pass-through or statutory line can be added on top: the fare_breakdown carries no ERP lines at all (tolls_erp 0.00), a zero airport surcharge - this trip does not ORIGINATE at an airport, it ends in Pasir Ris - and a zero waiting-time fee, so properly_chargeable totals 0.00. No POL-RD-09 pass-through correction and no POL-RD-11(b) correction is due, and the rider's narrative of a KPE and TPE detour is tied to no gantry line whatsoever.

Every charge line on this fare_breakdown reconciles to the trace and the rate card: distance_fare 12.24 is 0.75 x 16.32 km charged, time_fare 7.56 is 0.28 x 27 min, base_fare 3.80 and platform_fee 0.80 are the rate card items. There is no over-billed distance, no over-billed time and no unmatched charge line, so neither a billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4) nor a POL-RD-10(8) escalation is available on this record.

The gps_trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 164 fixes at a 10 s cadence, max_gap_sec 10.0 (no gap above 90 s), and a largest straight-line step of 150.1 m (no jump above 500 m), so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) do not fire. The 16.32 km trace figure therefore stands as measured without discount, and POL-RD-10(3) does not require this case to be held back from a monetary ruling.

The traffic advisory for this trip is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-04004-01 carries status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment. No party cited it - the driver's statement asserts only that he followed the navigation and names no road, no closure and no advisory ID. Under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it and is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger; under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the measured figure and the case is decided on the record. The absent artifact can carry no fact.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this dispute turns on one figure, and the record supplies it clearly.

What happened. The trip was booked at a fixed upfront price of $17.90 (EV-TRIP-04004, EV-FARE-04004). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-04004) shows the car covered 16.32 km against the 12.10 km route the platform priced at booking — an excess of 4.22 km, or 34.88%. That passes the establishment test in POL-RD-01 (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so a route deviation did occur. It does not pass the materiality limbs (8.0 km / 50%), so the deviation is established but not material. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is therefore not required by materiality, and in any event driver D-4102 has 0 deviation flags in the last 90 days over 280 completed trips — no pattern, and so no driver-conduct referral.

Why the refund is $6.50. Because this is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip, POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, the rider did not lose them to the detour, and none of them is refunded. What applies is POL-RD-11(a) — everything charged above the $17.90 quote and above the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. The ledger (EV-FARE-04004) charges $24.40, and carries no ERP gantry lines ($0.00), no airport surcharge ($0.00 — this trip ends in Pasir Ris, it does not originate at an airport) and no waiting fee ($0.00). So $24.40 − $17.90 − $0.00 = $6.50, which is already a multiple of 5 cents. That is the whole contested amount, so the rider is entirely right and the outcome is FULL_REFUND.

The points each side raised, answered together:
- The trace is sound. POL-RD-07 impairs a trace only on a gap over 90 s, a step over 500 m or a cadence over 30 s; this trace has 164 fixes at a 10 s cadence, a longest gap of 10 s and a longest step of 150.1 m. None of limbs (a)–(c) fires, so the deviation stands on this trip's own measurement and no POL-RD-10(3) hold-back applies.
- No rider instruction caused the detour. The chat log (EV-CHAT-04004) holds two pickup-logistics messages, neither from the rider naming a place or road and neither carrying a waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run and no distance is excluded.
- The driver's traffic position carries no weight. The traffic advisory for this trip (EV-ADVIS-04004-01) is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — disclosed by both sides. The driver's statement names no advisory and says only that he followed the navigation. Under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction; POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the deviation stands at the measured figure.
- The counterparty statement ('I just follow the navigation; the fare is calculated by the app') cites no evidence and concedes nothing against the driver's interest, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight against the trace and nothing on the record is decided by it.
- No billing-integrity failure: distance fare 12.24 (0.75 × 16.32 km), time fare 7.56 (0.28 × 27 min), base fare 3.80 and platform fee 0.80 all reconcile to the trace and the rate card, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral fires.
- No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: trip identifiers match (TRP-04004), timestamps are causally ordered, the trace is unimpaired, and the $6.50 remedy is far below the $150.00 ceiling.

No clause in this case produces a referral. The monetary effect of $6.50 is at or below the $8.00 execution threshold, so the refund is executed automatically on issue. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
